usage: REVIEW ONLY. This artifact is NOT directly usable as --label-overrides. It contains unaccepted alternatives and no accepted override ingestion contract. Select the reference convention and adjudicate review holds before creating a separate accepted overlay.

reference_convention.object_relative: Initial target position relative to other visible candidate boxes in the robot-camera image. Front/back use camera-relative table positions, not size alone. Omit lateral wording where the other candidate is missing or lateral ordering is ambiguous.
reference_convention.workspace_relative: Initial target position within the visible table/workspace as seen by the robot camera. Left/right is not a hard image-center threshold and is not necessarily relative to another box.
reference_convention.decision: User selection pending; preserve both proposals without choosing between them.

path_conventions.source_data_json_and_image_path: POSIX paths relative to the dataset root, whose directory name is dataset_name. No machine-specific root is stored.
path_conventions.source_audit_report_and_provenance_repos: POSIX paths relative to the repository root. Audit reports and inventory are local provenance inputs; their hashes identify the source revisions even if those files are not distributed.
path_conventions.data_row_offset: Zero-based position in current data.json data array.
path_conventions.source_idx: The exact idx field of that source row; may differ from data_row_offset after trimming.
path_conventions.image_frame_number: Numeric filename prefix, independently checked against the source row and source_idx.
path_conventions.hashes: SHA-256 of exact local file bytes; source metadata must match the frozen inventory. Missing images have no inferred hash.

status_semantics.candidate_matches_original: Proposed wording agrees with the original under this reference convention; not accepted for conversion.
status_semantics.candidate_change: Proposed wording differs under this reference convention; not accepted for conversion.
status_semantics.needs_review: Evidence or recording issue blocks acceptance regardless of the pending convention.
status_semantics.source_audit_status: Preserved source assessment. verified is a visual finding under a convention, not an accepted override.
status_semantics.decision_status: All entries remain not_accepted_in_this_artifact. Separate accepted overlays are independent decision artifacts.

confidence_semantics: Source confidence values are preserved. Early/late audits use qualitative high/medium; the middle audit uses numeric scores from 0 to 1. They are reviewer assessments, not calibrated probabilities.

provenance.supplemental_assessment: Early audit final confirmation, relayed by the coordinating reviewer, supports workspace-relative left/front for all 42 early episodes. This supplements early rows lacking an explicit workspace field.
